name: tower_of_hanoi_benchmark
description: A benchmark of Tower of Hanoi problem instances intended to evaluate agents' planning, sequential decision-making, and algorithmic reasoning over discrete action sequences. Tasks require producing or executing an action sequence that moves all disks to the target peg following puzzle constraints; difficulty scales with number of disks. It measures whether models/agents can discover and execute optimal or valid solution traces under limited step budgets.
reputation: Niche benchmark used in reinforcement learning and planning research for evaluating symbolic/algorithmic reasoning capabilities; moderate visibility within those communities.
